categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Jiayuan Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, manufacturing, and sales of various high-performance electrolytic copper foils, including lithium battery copper foil and electronic circuit copper foil. The company also develops and sells high-performance precision copper wires and has diversified into photovoltaic energy, energy storage, and copper wire processing businesses. It operates multiple subsidiaries focusing on copper foil production, copper wire manufacturing, and new energy technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced electrolytic copper foil manufacturing technologies including ultra-thin and extremely thin copper foil production, additive technology, cathode roller grinding, copper dissolution, copper powder cleaning, precision slitting, wastewater treatment, and copper foil inspection technologies. It has developed proprietary additive technologies and mastered key processes for high-strength, high-elongation, and low-warp copper foils, with significant R&D investment and numerous patents supporting continuous innovation and product iteration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are mainly lithium-ion battery manufacturers serving the new energy vehicle, energy storage, and 3C digital electronics sectors. The company has established long-term stable partnerships with leading domestic lithium battery producers such as CATL and other major battery enterprises. Its products are also used in printed circuit boards (PCB) and copper clad laminates (CCL) for electronics, telecommunications, and automotive industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Guangdong (Meizhou), Fujian (Ningde), Jiangxi (Ganzhou), Shandong (Liaocheng), Hunan (Hengyang), and Shenzhen. It serves domestic markets extensively and is actively expanding into overseas markets including Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, and Southeast Asia through dedicated international logistics and customer service centers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiayuan Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the production of electrolytic copper foil and precision copper wire, which are key upstream materials for lithium-ion battery and PCB manufacturers. The company also integrates upstream copper wire processing and downstream photovoltaic and energy storage projects, extending its presence along the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a focus on developing thinner, higher-performance copper foils, including ultra-high strength, high elongation, micro-porous, single crystal, and composite copper foils. It invests heavily in R&D, collaborates with academic and research institutions, and pursues breakthroughs in solid-state battery copper foil and high-frequency PCB copper foil technologies. The strategic R&D direction also includes expanding into new energy materials and precision copper wire technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of high-performance electrolytic copper foil products and precision copper wires. The company also earns income from photovoltaic EPC projects and copper alloy sales. Sales are mainly conducted via direct sales contracts with major customers, supplemented by some distribution channels. The pricing model for copper foil products typically follows a 'copper price plus processing fee' structure.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiayuan Technology is positioned as a leading domestic player in the high-performance lithium battery copper foil industry, ranking among the top in production capacity and technology. It competes with other domestic and international copper foil manufacturers, facing intensified competition due to industry overcapacity and price pressure. The company emphasizes its technological edge, product quality, and strategic partnerships to maintain a leading market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 6.52 billion, a 31.27% increase year-over-year, driven by increased sales volume and diversified business growth. However, net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 238.83 million, reflecting significant margin pressure and increased costs. Total assets reached RMB 13.04 billion, with net assets of RMB 6.90 billion. The company continues to expand production capacity, aiming for over 110,000 tons annual copper foil capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiayuan Technology differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies enabling the production of ultra-thin, high-strength, and high-elongation copper foils tailored for high-end applications such as new energy vehicles, energy storage, and high-frequency PCBs. Its comprehensive quality control system, strong R&D capabilities, and strategic customer partnerships provide reliable, high-performance materials that support customers' innovation and product performance needs. The company also emphasizes green manufacturing and sustainable practices as part of its value proposition.
